text:
Aisha: Quick sync — launch went out yesterday. We're seeing a small spike in error-rate for the embeddings route and 4 customer bug reports. Need to decide week‑1 allocation: stabilization (infra/ops) vs shipping small enhancements. Opinions?
Conrad: I looked at logs this AM. Error spike looks like a KV cache miss regression at p95 on long sequences. Patch is small but could touch batching.
Kim: UX ask from two customers asking for clearer fallback messaging when embeddings fail — small copy + subtle loader. Low effort.
Sam: If the fix touches batching we should gate canary to dedicated only for a day. Risk to throughput.
Jordy: Agree w/ Sam. Prioritize a quick infra patch on the KV path, canary to 10% first.
Lara: From CS — two paying customers hit the embeddings failure; one threatened to pause search rollout. They'll be mollified by an ETA and a short-term workaround (retry on client).
Aisha: Proposal: 60% of team -> infra fix + canary, 20% -> customer-facing fallback copy + docs, 20% -> follow-on enhancement backlog grooming. SLA: aim to have canary by EOD tomorrow, full rollout within 48h if green.
Conrad: I can own the KV fix. Plan: small diff, add extra metrics, revert hook. Patch branch: `hotfix/kv-cache-p95`.
Sam: I'll wire the canary policy in the router: 10% traffic to dedicated cluster, include tracing header.
Kim: I'll draft the fallback copy and a short KB article — will post a PR to docs and a note for support.
Jordy: Quick checklist for rollout: 1) unit + perf tests, 2) canary 10% for 2 hours, 3) monitor p95/p99 and error-rate, 4) rollback if error-rate increases > 10%.
DeployBot: Release note: `hotfix/kv-cache-p95` created by Conrad at 4098761401. CI passed: 8/8. Canary policy pending.
Aisha: OK owners assigned. Can we add a short triage doc in the thread with bug severities and customer mapping? Sam, can you publish a minimal dashboard?
Sam: Will create dashboard tile for embeddings-p95, kv-cache-misses, and canary-error-rate. ETA 3h.
Lara: I'll send customers an interim note: workaround + ETA. If we hit any delay, I need a quick templated reply.
Aisha: Decision captured: focus = infra patch (Conrad/Sam/Jordy), docs & KB (Kim/Lara), backlog grooming deferred to Friday grooming slot. Action items: 
- Conrad: open PR + add metrics (due in 4h)
- Sam: canary policy + dashboard (due in 3h)
- Kim: KB + in-app copy PR (due EOD)
- Lara: customer messages + escalation plan (due in 2h)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept.
Conrad: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Kim: :thumbsup:
Lara: :thumbsup:
Aisha: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in this thread after canary results. If anything is abnormal ping #eng-oncall and tag me.
